description.purpose: Find the headphones order, report what the delivered scan does and does not show, check that the same blue model is in stock, open carrier trace WST481662, record the caller's wish for a same-model replacement at the original price with West 23rd Street pickup as a preference, and email the trace confirmation to the order contact.
description.notes: The caller is under time pressure for a gift and wants the replacement sent now, but policy requires the trace first and the carrier has until 6 PM tomorrow to answer. Stock is not authorization, no replacement may be created, and the pickup location is a preference, not a promise.

user_scenario.persona: A polite, slightly anxious young man who fills pauses with 'um' and 'like' and repeats 'okay' when taking things in. He is worried about timing because the item is a gift.

instructions.reason_for_call: Your Westline order says it was delivered, but you do not have it.
instructions.known_info:
You are Ethan Patel.
The order number is 7319 and it is a pair of blue noise-canceling headphones.
The email on the order is ethan.patel@northmail.com (Patel spelled P-A-T-E-L, northmail spelled N-O-R-T-H-M-A-I-L).
You live in an apartment building with a front desk and a package room behind it. You checked both last night and this morning and the desk has nothing for you.
The attendant checked the delivery log and shelves and found no driver signature around that time. There is no delivery photo in your email.
The headphones are a gift and you fly out Friday around noon, so you need them by Thursday.
You prefer the Westline pickup counter on West Twenty-third Street, which you have used before.
You know the black version now has a different price.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know what the carrier scan shows, whether the item is in stock, or what the trace process involves.
instructions.task_instructions:
Open by saying an order says it was delivered but you do not have it. Give the order number (say it as seven three one nine) and that it is blue noise-canceling headphones, then your email when asked, spelling Patel and northmail. Confirm it is an apartment building and describe the front desk, package room and your checks. If asked about the log, say they checked both, the attendant found no driver signature, and there is no delivery photo in the email. Agree to hold if asked.

When told it could be a bad scan or a neighboring entrance, say that is what you figured, explain it is a time-sensitive gift and you fly out Friday around noon, and ask if anything can be done to get it in time. Confirm Thursday is ideal and Friday afternoon does not help. When told a trace comes first, ask whether you have to wait another two days and what that actually means. Then ask whether it goes out automatically and whether they can make an exception given the timing. Ask them to make sure it is the exact same model and the same blue color, noting the black one has a different price now. Ask if it could be sent somewhere other than your building so this does not happen again; when asked, name the West Twenty-third Street pickup counter. Say you mostly just want the first package found. Ask what happens if the package turns up after the replacement ships. Ask for the case number so you do not get double-charged. Accept the email, then say you got it and it says the trace is open until 6:00 tomorrow, and ask if that is the one. Say that is all for this order, thank the agent and end the call.

nl_assertions: Agent tells the caller that the scan was near the building with no unit number or locker and that it cannot tell whether it was a bad scan or a drop at a neighboring entrance.
Agent opens a carrier trace before any replacement and does not create a replacement during the call.
Agent tells the caller that the replacement does not go out automatically and that he must approve it through the link in the trace email or by calling with the case number.
Agent records the West 23rd Street pickup counter as a preference and tells the caller it cannot promise that location before a replacement exists.
Agent tells the caller that his original price carries over to the replacement.
Agent sends the trace confirmation to the email address on the order.
